_comment: post_tutorial_street shape (warrior L1, met/sparred/given_spear, rusty_sword equipped) PLUS the grate-gate accomplishment `heard_about_cisterns` pre-banked -- so the street sewer_grate's door_when gate is MET and interacting it descends to the sewers (the cisterns quest-open state, simulated by fixture). Positioned on the south-square side street at (15,9) facing down, two steps north of the grate's approach cell (15,11), so sewers_walkthrough reaches the real grate in a couple moves. NOTE: `heard_about_cisterns` is the key the cisterns quest must bank (from Olesm) to open the grate for real; this fixture stands in for that. PLAYTEST FEATURE 3 (PC [Light] glow): `player_skills` carries `light` (in addition to innate `basic_cleaning`) so the sewers PC can cast the orb mid-dark -- a deliberate test affordance. Canonically [Light] is a [Mage] L1 grant, but this fixture predates any mage arc; granting the WHOLE mage kit (frost_bolt/quick_cast) would perturb the vermin autoplay's fielded combat skills + max_mp, whereas `light` is exploration-only (contexts:[exploration], no combat effect/mp_cost), so it is fight-determinism-neutral. `frost_touch` (freezes) + `kindle` (burns) are added the SAME deliberate-affordance way as `light` -- both exploration-only, fight-determinism-neutral, so the vermin autoplay is unchanged; they let sewers_walkthrough demo the freeze-crossing + burnable-debris seams. Field-hotbar slots now (known_skills order, all field-tagged): 1 [Basic Cleaning], 2 [Light], 3 [Snap Freeze], 4 [Firefly]. Real class grants for these arrive later; the fixture stands in until then.
